title: Compression Through a Context Lens: Evaluating Adaptation, Quantization, and Distillation in Arabic Legal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07988v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model compression can facilitate the deployment of large language models in resource-constrained legal settings, but its effects on domain-specific performance may depend on the evaluation protocol. We investigate this issue using ArabLegalEval, a Saudi Arabic legal benchmark, under both with-context and no-context evaluation. The former provides supporting legal passages, while the latter assesses performance without external context. Removing the context produces accuracy gaps of up to 27 percentage points for the base model. We examine three stages: domain adaptation, quantization, and knowledge distillation across FANAR-9B, JAIS-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B. Four-bit quantization reduces model memory by 64-71%, with changes in no-context MCQ accuracy ranging from -3.2 to +1.6 percentage points. Distillation produces more variable results, with accuracy generally declining as student size decreases. A Qwen2.5-7B student distilled from FANAR ach

translated_title: 通过上下文视角看模型压缩：评估阿拉伯语法律大语言模型中的领域适应、量化与蒸馏
translated_abstract: 模型压缩可以促进大语言模型在资源受限的法律场景中的部署，但其对特定领域性能的影响可能取决于评估协议。我们使用沙特阿拉伯法律基准ArabLegalEval，在有上下文和无上下文两种评估模式下研究这一问题。前者提供支持性的法律段落，而后者在没有外部上下文的情况下评估性能。移除上下文导致基础模型的准确率差距高达27个百分点。我们在FANAR-9B、JAIS-8B和Qwen2.5-7B三个模型上考察了三个阶段：领域适应、量化和知识蒸馏。4比特量化将模型内存减少了64-71%，而无上下文多项选择题准确率的变化范围在-3.2至+1.6个百分点之间。蒸馏产生的结果更具变异性，随着学生模型规模的减小，准确率普遍下降。从FANAR蒸馏而来的Qwen2.5-7B学生模型……
tldr: 该研究在沙特阿拉伯法律基准ArabLegalEval上系统评估了领域适应、量化和知识蒸馏三种压缩技术对阿拉伯语法律大语言模型的影响，揭示了压缩对性能的影响高度依赖于有上下文与无上下文的评估协议，其中4比特量化可将内存减少64-71%且几乎不损失性能。
